documentation.content: The hourly monitorPendingDeletions sweep failed to drain a pendingDeletions record — an account deletion may be stuck mid-cascade (GDPR Art. 17 risk). Inspect pendingDeletions/{uid} and the userDeletionCleanupQueue / postDeletionQueue. Source: monitorPendingDeletions in functions/index.js.

conditionMatchedLog.filter: textPayload:"Retry failed for pending deletion" AND severity>=ERROR
